entries.title: Job 6:1
segments: ¶And Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 6:2
segments: Oh that my grief were thoroughly weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!

entries.title: Job 6:3
segments: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas; therefore my words are vehement.

entries.title: Job 6:4
segments: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, their poison drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of +God are arrayed against me.

entries.title: Job 6:5
segments: Doth the wild ass bray by the grass? loweth an ox over his fodder?

entries.title: Job 6:6
segments: Shall that which is insipid be eaten without salt? Is there any taste in the white of an egg?

entries.title: Job 6:7
segments: What my soul refuseth to touch, that is as my loathsome food.

entries.title: Job 6:8
segments: ¶Oh that I might have my request, and that +God would grant my desire!

entries.title: Job 6:9
segments: And that it would please +God to crush me, that he would let loose his hand and cut me off!

entries.title: Job 6:10
segments: Then should I yet have comfort; and in the pain which spareth not I would rejoice that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

entries.title: Job 6:11
segments: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should have patience?

entries.title: Job 6:12
segments: Is my strength the strength of stones? is my flesh of brass?

entries.title: Job 6:13
segments: Is it not that there is no help in me, and soundness is driven away from me?

entries.title: Job 6:14
segments: ¶For him that is fainting kindness [is meet] from his friend; or he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 6:15
segments: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a stream, as the channel of streams which pass away,

entries.title: Job 6:16
segments: Which are turbid by reason of the ice, in which the snow hideth itself:

entries.title: Job 6:17
segments: At the time they diminish, they are dried up; when heat affecteth them, they vanish from their place:

entries.title: Job 6:18
segments: They wind about in the paths of their course, they go off into the waste and perish.

entries.title: Job 6:19
segments: The caravans of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba counted on them:

entries.title: Job 6:20
segments: They are ashamed at their hope; they come thither, and are confounded.

entries.title: Job 6:21
segments: So now ye are nothing; ye see a terrible object and are afraid.

entries.title: Job 6:22
segments: ¶Did I say, Bring unto me, and make me a present from your substance?

entries.title: Job 6:23
segments: Or, rescue me from the hand of the oppressor, and redeem me from the hand of the violent?

entries.title: Job 6:24
segments: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue; and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

entries.title: Job 6:25
segments: How forcible are right words! but what doth your upbraiding reprove?

entries.title: Job 6:26
segments: Do ye imagine to reprove words? The speeches of one that is desperate are indeed for the wind.

entries.title: Job 6:27
segments: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and dig [a pit] for your friend.

entries.title: Job 6:28
segments: Now therefore if ye will, look upon me; and it shall be to your face if I lie.

entries.title: Job 6:29
segments: Return, I pray you, let there be no wrong; yea, return again, my righteousness shall be in it.

entries.title: Job 6:30
segments: Is there wrong in my tongue? cannot my taste discern mischievous things?
